title: governed ENDF-6 legality relaxation + identical-data leg re-execution

reclassification.W-183: P37 labeled actinv_strictness on the first rejection; after the two real strictness fixes (negative-spin parity, zero-NRS placeholder LIST) a deeper defect surfaced: MT28/MF=10 states exceed the MF=3 total by 2.108992e-3 (outside the frozen 0.001 envelope). W-183 now stands as true_defect; the P37 record is amended, not rewritten.

code_changes.builder.rs: MF=10-only sections (no MF=3, no fission sentinel) admit with the MF=10 partial sum as the runtime comparator, ledgered missing_total_self_comparator (internal completeness, not anchored conservation)
code_changes.resonance.rs: negative IA/IB spins admitted (ENDF-6 parity encoding; downstream uses spin magnitudes); zero-NRS spin groups tolerate a SAMMY all-zero placeholder LIST row; N2=NRS still enforced for NRS>0

identical_data_findings.executability: the arm now executes end-to-end: 40/40 sampled cases ran both arms with zero arm failures
identical_data_findings.comparison_validity: NOT a solver-agreement measurement. The two FENDL processing paths diverge in channel content.
identical_data_findings.dominant_gap: ACTINV's builder skips lumped-channel MTs 600-849 (ENDF-6 discrete-state n,p/n,d/n,t/n,h/n,alpha channels). FENDL carries charged-particle production only there for Fe-56, Mn-55, W-180 and partially for Fe-54/Fe-58/Ag-109. ALARA's REAC conversion reads them.

measured_pattern.at_shutdown: ALARA/ACTINV activity ratio 1.2x-200x (worst under IRDFF fast spectrum, 200x on pure Fe) - short-lived charged-particle products (Mn-56, Mn-57) absent from the ACTINV artifact
measured_pattern.at_9y_cooling: ALARA/ACTINV = 0.995-1.011 on ~90% of sampled cases - capture-dominated products agree within ~1%
measured_pattern.exceptions: fe_mo100000wppm irdff late-time 17.5x; divergence runs both directions (ACTINV emits Fe-55/Mn-54 rows ALARA does not list)

identical_data_findings.interpretation: early-time and fast-spectrum responses are coverage-limited; late-time capture-dominated responses already agree at percent level. The frozen 5e-4 tolerance fails comprehensively and honestly records the coverage gap.

conditions: the MF10 self-comparator is internal completeness, NOT independently anchored conservation; it is ledgered per-MT in the artifact index
admitted files are legal ENDF-6 in FORMAT; this phase asserts nothing about their evaluation quality
the identical-data leg remains comparison-invalid at early times and under fast spectra until lumped-MT coverage (600-849) and any MF6-residual-only channels land - named as the next blocker
the 912/1016 census is structural executability, not a validity claim
W-183's reclassification narrows P37's strictness class to 7 files; the sealed P37 record is preserved and amended here
this phase changes data admission and coverage only - no solver, decay, or tolerance semantics changed

claims.artifact_built: 31/36 FENDL-3.2c contract parents build under the relaxed legality contract
claims.identical_data_executable: 912/1016 contract cases are structurally executable; 40 sampled and executed end-to-end
claims.defects_still_rejected: Ni-62, W-182, W-183, W-184, W-186 all fail their original gates with named reasons
claims.comparison_gap_measured: ALARA-vs-ACTINV identical-data responses diverge at t=0 by 1.2x-200x and agree at 9y cooling within ~1% on most cases - a coverage finding, not a solver claim
